notes.title: Soundtrack available and celebratory Dev Stream
notes.content:
The soundtrack of [i]Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn[/i] is finally released as a standalone soundtrack, meaning anyone can purchase the soundtrack without limitations on having to own the game.
Check it out -> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1382780/Unforgiving__A_Northern_Hymn_Soundtrack/]Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn OST on steam[/url]

We will celebrate with a[b] dev stream[/b] on twitch where we will play through Unforgiving and talk about it. You can[b] ask any question[/b] you might have around Unforgiving, Swedish folklore or the studio. We will also be [b]giving away keys for the soundtrack during stream[/b]!

Come hang out with us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/angrydemonstudio]Angry Demon Twitch Channel[/url] today (2020-08-14) at 17:00 CEST!

notes.title: Gori Demo Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Wanna fight creepy toys and slice some unicorns as a murder-kitty on a Hoverboard?[/h1]

Gori: Cuddly Carnage is our latest game where we want the player to face ugly, disgusting and cute creatures and then slice them to pieces.

We are super excited to make this game and really want to make it the best we possibly can!
Give the alpha demo a try and add it to your wishlist if you like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299690/Gori_Cuddly_Carnage/

Thank you for purchasing and playing our games, we love you guys! // Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Version 1.2 live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We have patched Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn… And it’s a big one this time!
[list]
 [*]English speech added as an option
 [*]Possibility for black bars to maintain aspect ratio when using other ratios than 16:9
 [*]Improvements in UI
 [*]Environmental improvements for navigational purposes
 [*]Full paus-function during gameplay.
 [*]Puzzle design enhanced
 [*]Huldra AI-behavior altered
 [*]Italian, English and Swedish subs corrected
 [*]Minor event-correction and clarification
 [*]Minor menu updates
[/list]
We hope players will enjoy these updates!

Take care // Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Fixes and updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

At the same time as we work on our new project we are still trying to maintain Unforgving. A big thank you to everyone reporting issues and errors and for all the feedback we get! We really appreciate it all!

We recently patched the game with:

- New french subtitling,
- Fixes of minor bugs and issues.

We'll keep you guys posted on all updates on Unforgiving and our new project!

Regards // Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Translation corrections
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

As some of you might know we’ve been struggling with German and Japanese translations for a while.
But finally, we’re happy to announce that the fifth time's the charm because of 3 awesome individuals who helped us to finally get it right!

Pengin and Marcel Weyers (www.marcel-weyers.de)! Thank you so much for the new German translations! You guys really saved our bacon on this one!

On Takahashi (https://www.facebook.com/on.takahashi)! Your corrections of the existing translations will finally bring the correct feelings across for all our Japanese players!

It makes us so happy to be part of such an amazing and open indie game community where developers and individuals from all over the world help each other in the making of new content. We’ll make sure to pass along the kindness and support that has been shown to us! ːsteamhappyː 

// Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Soundtrack and Art Book available!
notes.content:
[b]Good news for fans of the Soundtrack and for the ones curious about the stories and art of Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn![/b]

Due to popular demand we’ve made the complete soundtrack (including the Näcken theme) available together with a digital artbook for purchase here:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/795650/Unforgiving__A_Northern_Hymn_Soundtrack_and_Art_Book/] Soundtrack + Artbook Steam Page	[/url]

The soundtrack comes in high quality format and easy to carry format (Flac and Mp3)!

The digital, high resolution Art Book contains exclusive images of all our creatures together with the stories that was the foundation for Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn!
 [b]The Art Book will only be available in English[/b]

By purchasing this DLC you’re also supporting Angry Demon Studio, a very small indie-studio in the venture of creating new and terrifying games. We really appreciate all the support we can get! ːsteamhappyː

We have also hired new translators for German and Japanese subtitles since the ones we hired before delivered sub-par sub-titling. These new subtitles should be publicly available next week around 8/2 - 18 ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Major Update! Updated subs, 日本語字幕あり, gameplayfixes and more!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’ve been watching as many letsplays and streams as we've possibly can. We’ve also read comments on our disscussionboard and on other announcements at the same time as we’ve listened to feedback through messages everywhere.
This has resulted in a major patch of Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn that’s live now! 

Version 1.1.0 includes:
- Added Japanese subtitling (Five keys available for verified Japanese 
  letsplayers/streamers, first come first serve)
- Fixed german subtitles (We got ripped off twice by our translator and we don’t 
  know any German :( )
- Fixed Russian subtitles
- Major level changes resulting in a much shorter walk in the beginning
- Fixed collision issues
- Made it easier to find the right path after the marsh
- Falling out of the zipline cage no longer occurs

// Angry Demon Studio

We also added:

notes.title: First patch, 1.0.7
notes.content:
We have been watching a ton of playthroughs of the game and we’ve been squashing bugs and fixing gameplay problems as fast as we can.

Fixes for version 1.0.7

- Thai subtitles are now working
- Changed some things in the first puzzle in the swamp
- Fixed duplication of inventory items.
- Fixed problem where “ghast” (monsters in the mines) get stuck.
- Removed toggle fullscreen with F11 and alt + enter (it had some issues)
- Shorter transport time on raft and in zipline cage
- Fixed some weird twitching of Lukas
- Fixed sound effects not stopping after troll chase
- General gameplay improvements

notes.title: Smaller delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are sad to announce that the game will be delayed about 36 hours because of technical issues.
We know a lot of you have been looking forward to be able to play it today but we hope you can wait just a little bit more.
You will be able to get it soon and we hope you are excited about the release sale that the game will have the first week here on Steam.
// Angry Demon Studio

notes.title: Last touches before release
notes.content:
We are working on the last touches on the game right now and we are really excited about the upcoming release.

[b]Available languages:[/b]
As it stands right now the subtitling and UI available in the game are:

[b]English, Español, Русский, Nederlands, Italiano, 中文, Français, Deutsch, 한국어, Polski, ภาษาไทย, Português and of course audio and written text in Swedish.[/b]

[b]Achievements are available:[/b]
We have 16 achievements available in the game where one of them is a secret achievement. Our 2D-artist have put a lot of effort into those so I hope you will like them!
